feature_name: Capture and submit a queued page
scope: Proposed procedure-only replacement for existing case EXT-F-2002-T01. No inventory status, cells, control status, runtime evidence, or product behavior is changed or claimed.

proposed_changes.title: Capture, continue, paste, retry, and resolve owned queued sources

control_link_exceptions.reason: The inventory describes a per-source capture-intensity picker, but current source exposes only queue filtering/grouping. Keep C08 unlinked and uncovered until the inventory/source mismatch is reconciled; do not count any queue filter or group interaction as coverage of C08.

The current PasteRow source renders a textarea and Submit paste but no cancel-editor control. Keep C10 unlinked and uncovered until the inventory/source mismatch is reconciled; do not infer cancel behavior from leaving the row.

guest.reason: Tasks tab audience is signed-in; canAccessSidepanelTab returns viewer.signedIn for signed-in tabs, and App gates both its trigger and content through canAccess('tasks'). EXT-F-2002-T01 is not the guest denial case.

member.reason: Tasks is available to signed-in viewers without an admin predicate; feature inventory already marks member applicable. Queue and writes still require actual member role and explicitly selected device organization.

admin.reason: Tasks is available to signed-in viewers; feature inventory already marks admin applicable. Use an actual admin principal and explicitly selected device organization.

preconditions: For each member and admin run, use a separate, real signed-in profile and an explicitly selected device organization. Capture the principal role and organization in the receipt; do not use the active organization as a list filter or infer member access from admin access.

Complete the resource permit and full build receipt required by docs/stabilization/PLAN.md § Build and reload contract. Use the approved receipt-bound extension artifact, verify loaded extension identity and source/tree hashes, reopen the actual side panel, and reload the controlled target pages after any applicable extension reload. Record no secrets.

Use only campaign-owned disposable queued sources in the selected organization, with known URLs and known queue buckets. Prepare separate owned rows for the automated, user-gated, paste, retry, and verdict branches, plus rows in each bucket for filter checks. For terminal verdicts, use only sacrificial owned sources with established cleanup ownership. If a required owned row or a naturally qualifying thin response is unavailable, leave that branch unverified; do not repurpose personal/organization records or fabricate backend responses.
Keep one owned ordinary page open in the disposable profile for the source-link check. Do not use an everyday browsing profile. Record fixture identifiers only, not page text or credential data.
steps: In Tasks, click the toolbar toggle with title 'Group by capture level', then 'Group by project'; confirm the visible queue switches between level sections and project groups. [C20, C21]

Click the toolbar button with title 'Filters'. Under the exact group heading 'Capture level', select each available queue bucket option in turn using owned fixture rows: 'L1 · Quick', 'L2 · Scroll', 'L3 · Needs help', 'L4 · Paste', 'Sign-in', and 'Low-value'. For each, confirm only rows in that bucket remain; clear the bucket selection before the next option. Finish with 'Clear all filters' and confirm the full fixture queue returns. [C22-C28]

For the owned L1 source and then the owned L2 source, click its visible Run/Capture action while its URL is not already the active tab. Observe loading/error/success state and queue refresh. For L2, also observe page settling/scroll behavior on the controlled page. Record the actual terminal UI result; success and thin are distinct outcomes, and an explicit error is not a pass. [C01]

For the owned L3 user-gated source, click Trigger/Capture this tab. Confirm the target page becomes active and the in-page Matrx overlay appears. On this fixture, first click Cancel and confirm the overlay closes while the queued source remains available. On a separate L3 fixture, trigger again, complete the page gate yourself, and click Capture page in the overlay or Go in the side panel; wait for capture submission and inspect the row status. [C02, C04, C11]

On a separate owned L3 source, trigger the overlay and click 'Expect thin content'. If the response is thin, verify the source is resolved as accepted and the page tab is closed; if it is not thin, record that the auto-accept-thin branch was not exercised. Do not induce a thin response by mutating network/backend behavior. [C03]
On the controlled ordinary page, click the queued source URL and confirm it opens that source in a separate browser tab. Return to Tasks. [C12]

For the owned L4 source, enter a short synthetic marker string into the paste field and submit it. Observe success/error and whether the field clears; verify the queue refresh. On another L4 source, leave the editor without submitting and verify there was no content submission. This is a no-submit observation only; C10 remains unlinked because no cancel-editor control is present in source. [C09]

For a source with a prior capture attempt, open Resolve and verify 'Retry from scratch' is available; select it and observe the queue refresh/requeue. Separately, if an owned capture action produces a real recoverable error, click the row's Run/Trigger action again and observe whether a new attempt starts. If no error occurs, leave retry-after-error coverage unverified. [C05, C13, C17]

Using separate disposable owned sources, open Resolve and exercise the exact source labels 'This is the whole page', 'Page is gated', 'Page is dead / 404', 'Wrong content — not what it should be', and 'Ignore — don't want it'. On a source with a prior attempt, also exercise 'Retry from scratch'. Observe pending state, result/error feedback and queue refresh for each; do not choose any terminal verdict for non-disposable records. [C06, C14-C19]

Repeat the applicable warm procedure for each role after the exact extension reload/reopen and controlled-page reload required by PLAN.md. Compare observations independently by role; do not reuse a prior run's result.
expected: Grouping toggles display the queue by capture level or by project according to the selected mode. These are grouping controls and do not change any source's assigned capture level.

The Filters popover opens. Each exact capture-level option filters the rows to its corresponding bucket; clearing the filters restores the full fixture queue. This behavior is proposed under fresh filter control IDs only and does not cover C08's per-source intensity-picker description.

L1/L2 actions visibly enter loading phases and either show a successful/thin result followed by queue refresh or a specific recoverable error. Record observed tab behavior without treating unverified backend/parser outcomes as fixed.

L3 Trigger opens the user-gate overlay and waits for an explicit person action. Cancel removes the overlay and clears local in-progress state without submitting capture or removing the queued source. Capture page/Go removes the overlay and submits the currently loaded page; successful thin capture exposes its verdict card, while errors remain visible.

Expect thin content only auto-applies accept_as_is when the returned capture is thin. A non-thin response does not prove the conditional accept branch; unavailable fixture behavior remains unverified. The overlay action attempts to close its tab after capture completes.
The source URL link opens its URL in a separate tab; the Tasks side panel and source row remain available.

Paste submission with non-empty content sends trimmed text for that queued source, shows success or a specific error, and clears the local paste value only after success. Empty content cannot be submitted. The no-submit observation does not establish a source-backed C10 cancel control.

Resolve → Retry is available only after a prior attempt. A successful retry requeues the source and it reappears after refresh. A real capture error remains visible and the row's Run/Trigger action is available for another attempt; absent an actual error, that recovery branch remains unverified.

The current source verdict catalog shows the exact labels 'This is the whole page', 'Wrong content — not what it should be', 'Page is gated', 'Page is dead / 404', 'Ignore — don't want it', and conditional 'Retry from scratch'. Successful terminal verdicts remove their owned source from the refreshed queue; Retry requeues it. Errors remain visible. The new Wrong content and Ignore controls are proposed additions; this proposal does not alter canonical inventory.

Warm and reload observations are recorded independently for member and admin. Guest applicability remains feature-level not-applicable per the signed-in Tasks audience; this case makes no guest-case or guest-runtime-coverage claim. This proposal itself leaves all inventory cells/evidence states unchanged.

proposed_additions.note: Proposed feature controls only; IDs follow the current maximum C17 and do not reuse the existing gap C07. Add them to canonical inventory only after fresh review. Each record includes the source-exact label and procedure behavior for the existing T01; statuses remain untouched.

controls.label: Wrong content — not what it should be
controls.action: Mark a loaded source as redirected or changed content, not a 404.
controls.step: On a disposable owned source that loaded as a different page, open Resolve and click 'Wrong content — not what it should be'.
controls.expected: The exact action is available; after successful resolution the source is removed from the refreshed queue. If the request fails, visible error feedback remains.

controls.label: Ignore — don't want it
controls.action: Stop surfacing a source that is not dead or gated.
controls.step: On a separate disposable owned source that is neither dead nor gated, open Resolve and click 'Ignore — don't want it'.
controls.expected: The exact action is available; after successful resolution the source is removed from the refreshed queue. If the request fails, visible error feedback remains.

evidence.finding: Procedures require resource admission and a receipt binding source/dirty hash, lock/output hashes, WXT mode, runtime ID, Chrome/profile, auth/role/org, permissions, backend identity and fixture IDs; extension reload/reopen and controlled target-tab reload are required where applicable. Warm and reloaded runs are distinct.
Case procedures need concrete reproduction, controlled data prerequisites, source-backed applicability, and no pass verdict from source reading.

EXT-F-2002 defines one broad case, EXT-F-2002-T01, existing control IDs C01-C17 except C07, modes member/admin, and guest/member/admin feature applicability. Case controls and useful reproduction details are currently absent/generic.
Tasks audience is signed-in; access returns signedIn for signed-in tabs.
Both Tasks navigation trigger and mounted Tasks content are gated by canAccess('tasks').

Source maps queue actions to the user-gate message handler, automated capture and L3 overlay/Go/expect-thin flows, cancel/pre-decided verdicts, HTML/media submission and thin verdict card, paste submit, retry/terminal resolution, source links, and visible row controls.
The L3 overlay is mounted in the target tab and exposes Cancel, Expect thin content, Capture page, Gated and 404/dead controls.
Queue buckets map to levels; current level sections include automated, user-gated, gated-login, manual paste and low-value; this supports fixture selection by known bucket.
Toolbar implements group-by-capture-level and a capture-level filter group. This does not expose a per-item intensity picker.
Resolve options are accept_as_is, content_mismatch, gated, dead_link, ignored and retry; retry is shown only after a prior attempt.

limits: This is source-only procedure design. No browser, build, test, backend, or live fixture was exercised; member/admin access and all runtime outcomes remain unverified.

C08 remains unlinked and uncovered: its inventory text describes a per-source intensity picker absent from current source. C10 remains unlinked and uncovered: PasteRow has no cancel-editor control. Fresh proposal IDs represent the separate, source-present queue group/filter controls.

Two current Resolve actions, 'Wrong content — not what it should be' and 'Ignore — don't want it', have proposed fresh control IDs C18/C19 because the canonical inventory has no corresponding controls. They remain additions pending fresh review.

The feature spans organization-scoped backend writes and terminal verdicts. Only campaign-owned disposable fixture sources with established cleanup ownership are safe for execution; if these fixtures are unavailable, the relevant procedures remain unverified.
